name: Delaware

context: DE 340: Cover crops are used to reduce erosion from wind and water, and to prevent wind erosion of soils.
DE 380: The protected zone on the leeward side of a windbreak is 10 times the maximum design height (H) of the tallest row of trees or shrubs at age 20.
cover_rules: DE 340: Cover crops cannot be destroyed until after March 15th. If spring peas are being planted, the cover crop can be destroyed after March 1st.
DE 340: Cover crops cannot be terminated earlier than 60 days from establishment. No grazing is allowed on cover crop acres.
residue: DE 329: Maintain a minimum of 60 percent residue cover on the soil surface throughout the year.
DE 329: Use the current approved water and wind erosion prediction technology to decide if planned field operations leave enough surface residue.
seeding: DE 340: 10/30 planting deadline applies only to single-species wheat, cereal rye, or triticale.
disturbed: DE 342: Plants for sand dunes and coastal sites must survive being buried by blowing sand, sand blasting, salt spray, drought, heat, and low nutrient supply.
DE 342: Include sand trapping devices such as sand fences or brush matting in revegetation or stabilization plans where applicable.

seedWin.text: DE 340: Planting deadlines are 10/1 for multi-species mixes and 10/15 for basic single-species cover crops.
